items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: So we take and switch between Tommy. But we told Tommy not to say nothing about it.

ctx.x: Well where was that? The Pershing Hotel? That's right.

The Pershing Hotel. That's where it was. Al Turner's old place, you see. Yeah. But Dave goes down to the Union, and the Union puts it in, that during that Dornell, or basically by the name of Moore, and myself couldn't quit. Dave could fight but we couldn't quit. Cause Dave was trying to keep us from going back down to the plantation with Joe. Yeah. You see, because Joe was taking his job. Yeah. Well anyhow, the way we did fix it around, Al Wynn was with Sam Wooding. Oh yes. You know. In Europe, yeah. And him and…
